title: bufferMAUSim
summary: A Jupyter Notebook/Python project that trains a linear regression model and uses a synthetic data backend to sample new records for prediction simulations. It relies on SDV's CTGANSynthesizer to fit and sample synthetic tabular data and on SDV's evaluate_quality to assess that synthetic data.
